faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our moving services, pricing, booking process and more.

questions.question: Do movers need to do an in-person survey to give an estimate?
questions.answer: Not always. For smaller moves, a virtual video call or detailed item list is sufficient. However, for larger homes or complex relocations, an in-person survey ensures the most accurate pricing.

questions.question: What happens if my new home isn't ready on moving day?
questions.answer: We offer secure, climate-controlled temporary storage facilities where your belongings can be safely kept until your new home is ready for delivery.

questions.question: What should I do if my belongings are damaged or lost?
questions.answer: All our relocations come with basic transit insurance coverage. In the rare event of damage, you can submit a claim with photos, and our claims team will process reimbursement promptly.

questions.question: Do you provide packing materials?
questions.answer: Yes! We bring high-quality bubble wrap, heavy-duty carton boxes, stretch film, mattress covers, and corrugated sheets to keep your items 100% safe.

questions.question: Can you move fragile or valuable items like pianos or antiques?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Our specialized team uses custom wooden crating and specialized padding for fragile, high-value items, artwork, and musical instruments.

questions.question: Do you offer storage facilities if needed?
questions.answer: Yes, we provide both short-term and long-term secure warehouse storage with 24/7 CCTV surveillance and climate monitoring.
